place.title: Kalkan Dream Hotel
place.address: Mentese Mah.ortaokul Sokak No:8, Kalkan, 07620, Türkiye

reviews.snippet: Es un sitio espectacular, cerca a todo caminando. La atención es muy buena, se esmeran por atenderte, las habitaciones con balcón y vista al mar, el desayuno excelente abundante, merece mi máxima calificación.

The most friendly and welcoming family run hotel.    Yeliz and Ergon and their team simply could not have done more to make our stay perfect. The rooms and the entire hotel was spotless. The large pool is fantastic with the most amazing sea view. There is a sea view from just about every room. We spent two weeks in September 2025 and although we are seasoned ‘Kalkaners’ we had not stayed at Dreams before but will definitely do so again. We felt as if we arrived as guests and left as friends !

очень хороший отель. номер просторный. чисто, ремонт свежий. убирают через день, мусор выносят каждый день. из номера на последнем этаже вид потрясающий на море. утюг предоставили бесплатно. персонал приветливый, разговорчивый.
